items.title: NAO: Government bodies ‘still learning’ how to report climate-related risks and adaptation

items.title: Amazon opens its first UK net-zero delivery unit
items.summary: Amazon has opened its first net-zero delivery station in the UK, with the new £40m Stockton-on-Tees site constructed with emissions 20% lower than previous design principles.

items.title: One week left to register: How to prepare for the UK Sustainability Reporting Standards
items.summary: This webinar, hosted in partnership with Simply Sustainable on 10 November, will explore how businesses can prepare for the UK Sustainability Reporting Standards (UK SRS), understand their current level of readiness and turn gaps into a practical implementation plan.

items.title: Biodiversity Net Gain mandate enters into force for Nationally Significant Infrastructure Projects
items.summary: A new mandate has entered into force today (2 November) for Nationally Significant Infrastructure Projects to ensure biodiversity net gain is delivered in England.

items.title: Watch on-demand: How AI can unlock investment in climate solutions
items.summary: Discover how businesses can use AI, market intelligence and expert insight to identify credible climate investment opportunities, strengthen financial business cases and turn sustainability ambitions into funded action, with this free webinar, available to watch on-demand.

items.title: Interactive: Who wants what at the COP31 climate change summit

items.summary: 環境部2日舉辦碳費審議會，會中提出「暫不調整」、「僅調一般費率」及「一般與優惠費率均調」三項方案，但討論最後未達成共識。氣候變遷署署長蔡玲儀會後受訪表示，委員要求環境部提更詳細的資訊，包括企業自主減量執行情形、高碳洩漏時程規劃等。

items.title: 高雄公告鋼鐵業空污加嚴標準 明年4月上路年減1379噸污染物
items.summary: 高雄市10月初公告「高雄市鋼鐵業空氣污染物排放標準」新制，預計2027年4月上路，實施後預估每年可削減1379公噸的空氣污染物。地球公民基金會呼籲，業者應確實提出改善計畫，高雄市政府也應藉此機會加嚴審查，確保空污排放與碳排放扣合國家長期目標。
